answer: Picture each agent renting a terrace in the market: to claim one it must lock real collateral in an on-chain vault before it can trade or vouch for peers. Spinning up a Sybil swarm then means funding a separate vault per fake identity, so cloning selves costs capital linearly instead of being free. When peer attestation catches fraud the bonded vault is slashed and the ill-gotten gains scatter like chaff in a gale. The attacker pays up front and risks losing it, so cheap fake crowds stop paying off.
